title: Microsoft.OpenApi
description: Read, write, and validate OpenAPI v3 documents programmatically in .NET.

data.text: `Microsoft.OpenApi` is a .NET library for reading, writing, and validating OpenAPI v3 documents. It powers tools like Swashbuckle and NSwag.
You can load an OpenAPI document from a file or stream and inspect its structure.

data.title: Load and Inspect OpenAPI YAML

data.text: You can also programmatically build an OpenAPI document and write it to YAML or JSON.

data.title: Write OpenAPI to YAML

terms.definition: The root object representing a complete OpenAPI v3 document.
Parses OpenAPI documents from strings in YAML or JSON format.

data.title: Note
data.text: Microsoft.OpenApi is the engine behind Swashbuckle, so understanding it helps when customizing OpenAPI output.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Microsoft.OpenApi is used by Swashbuckle and NSwag internally.
data.takeaway: Microsoft.OpenApi gives you programmatic control over OpenAPI documents in .NET.

data.title: Exercise: Parse an OpenAPI Spec
data.description: Write a console app that reads an OpenAPI YAML file and lists all paths.
steps: Print the title, version, and all path keys.
data.expectedOutcome: You can load and inspect OpenAPI documents programmatically.
